prompt: F3 work-roll bearing JSR.HR.STD3.WR.BRG01: AE RMS rose 0->8 dBuV over two weeks, envelope BPFO now 3.2 g, bearing temp 102 degC. Diagnose and advise.
diagnostic_reasoning_chain: AE.RMS crossed its 6 dBuV warning first - leading indicator of bearing surface distress (RCA-001).
Envelope BPFO 3.2 g is above the 3.0 g alarm -> energy at the outer-race ball-pass frequency = outer-race spall (ISO 15243).
Bearing temp 102 degC exceeds the 100 degC trip -> advanced stage, friction heating.
Three-sensor agreement (AE->BPFO->temp) over weeks matches the SCN-037 RTF signature, not a transient.
diagnosis: Outer-race rolling-contact fatigue spall (BPFO), advanced. Root cause: subsurface fatigue accelerated by lube contamination.
correct_resolution: LOTO + confirm zero-energy (SOP-01)
Controlled stop (temp>100C), no emergency trip
Hydraulic bearing puller; never strike bearing
Inspect journal vs OEM H7/k6, regrind if worn
Induction-heat new bearing 80-100C, laser-align <0.05mm
Replace coupling element + labyrinth seal
Verify <2.3mm/s, temp <70C at 60min

prompt: F1 gearbox JSR.HR.STD1.GBX01: GMF-band vibration jumped to 11 mm/s, oil ferrous count 60 ppm, chip detector tripped. What is wrong and what do I do?
diagnostic_reasoning_chain: GMF vibration 11 mm/s above the 10 mm/s alarm -> gross gear-mesh fault.
Ferrous 60 ppm vs 40 alarm + chip-detector trip -> chunky spall debris, active metal loss (ASTM D5185).
GMF + chip + Fe = tooth-root fatigue crack producing chunky spall (RCA-002), often after a high-torque cobble.
Risk: tooth fracture can damage the shaft - no deferral.
diagnosis: Gear-tooth fatigue crack with active spalling. Immediate controlled stop required.
correct_resolution: Immediate controlled stop (no deferral)
Remove gearbox via crane to repair bay
Replace gear wheel + bearings; set backlash 0.1-0.3mm
Prussian-blue contact >70% face
Run-in low load before full

diagnostic_reasoning_chain: MCSA sideband -34 dBc is past the -35 alarm -> rotor-bar fault confirmed (IEEE 1415).
DE vibration 4.8 mm/s with a 2x-slip component supports broken-bar mechanics.
Sidebands at (1-2s)f1 from repeated high-torque starts / thermal cycling (RCA-003).

Send failed motor for rotor-bar test + repair
Verify phase rotation before energising spare
